mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3+ consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 6.0%, it indicates labor market tightening that boosts corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 6.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in private employment growth signals robust labor market conditions that enhance corporate earnings visibility, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, rising industrial production indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and capital expenditure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-recession recovery periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate improving consumer confidence and residential investment, which correlates with stronger corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in industrial production signals monetary tightening coupled with economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness regimes, rising private employment growth signals sustained corporate hiring and wage growth that supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of high labor market tightness periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.
